# Percona Community

> Community site for people who run databases in production: events, talks, blog posts, speakers, and how to contribute. Not a product docs portal and not a SaaS API — content and community first.

This file is a curated map for AI agents and coding tools. Prefer these links over scraping every page. For a fuller inventory use the sitemap and the public search API. Markdown mirrors of hub and content pages are available by appending `.md` to a page URL (or fetching `/path/to/page.md`).

> For the complete site map for agents, see llms.txt.

## When to use this site

- Find upcoming or past Percona community events, meetups, and streams
- Look up talks, speakers, and talk videos
- Read practical blog posts about MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kubernetes, and related ops topics
- Learn how to contribute articles, talks, or open-source work
- Search community content (blog, talks, events, contributors) via the semantic search API or the on-site search page

Do not treat this site as the canonical product documentation for Percona Server, Operators, or PMM — use https://docs.percona.com/ for product docs.

## Primary sections

- [Home](https://percona.community/index.md): Overview of the community site
- [Events](https://percona.community/events.md): Upcoming and past events
- [Talks](https://percona.community/talks.md): Talk listings and abstracts
- [Talk videos](https://percona.community/videos.md): Recorded talks
- [Speakers](https://percona.community/contributor_type/speaker.md): Speaker directory (A–Z)
- [Authors](https://percona.community/contributor_type/author.md): Blog authors
- [Contributors / Maintainers](https://percona.community/contributors.md): Community maintainers hub
- [Blog](https://percona.community/blog.md): Community articles
- [Knowledge Base](https://percona.community/knowledge-base.md): How to get involved
- [Search](https://percona.community/search.md): Full search results UI
- [Developer docs](https://percona.community/developers.md): Community Search API quickstart

## Search API (for agents)

Public semantic search over indexed community content. No API key required for `POST /search`.

- Developer docs (markdown): https://percona.community/developers.md
- OpenAPI specification: https://percona.community/openapi.json
- Base URL: https://search.percona.community
- Health: https://search.percona.community/health
- Widget script: https://search.percona.community/community-search.js
- Site search page (markdown): https://percona.community/search.md

Admin demo/docs/indexing endpoints on that host may require HTTP Basic Auth and are not for public agent use.
